title: Twitter T3 TT WheelTop TX-TT7110 manufacturer specification recheck
notes: Live recheck of the exact T3 TT manufacturer page on 2026-09-24. The WheelTop TX-TT7110 2x12 table lists WheelTop derailleurs/brakes, Shimano 105 R7100 crank and cassette, HG6100 chain, RS 3K carbon W28xH60 mm wheels, Maxxis 700x28C tires and a carbon TT cockpit; a separate SRAM AXS build is not combined. The page states a sealed threaded T47x24 bottom bracket, 9.5 kg claim for the RS 60 mm WheelTop build, high-modulus carbon frame/fork and a six-size geometry chart (43.5–54). Its stiffness statement is qualitative marketing only. Weight size, included equipment and measurement method, and material lay-up remain unpublished.

classification_history.reason: Operator identifies itself as a regional U.S. distributor; authorization is self-described, not independently verified.

authority_note: Regional US distributor source. Its statement of authorization is self-described; this source is not the manufacturer or evidence of mainland-China price or warranty.
